maya: Quick note - found a small but repeatable bundler -> edge crash in the JS SDK when using a package that exports both a default class and named helpers. Build OK, edge runtime: "TypeError: SDK__default is not a constructor". Node builds unaffected.
maya: Minimal repro: helper publishes ESM + CJS fields, source exports `export default class Client {}` and `export function util(){}`. Vite (esbuild) and webpack (esbuild-loader) both produced a bundle where default became an object.
diego: Repro steps: build the edge bundle with target es2020 disabled -> triggers transpile -> class loses constructor identity. Quick fixes: set target modern (es2020+), or in SDK import defensively `import * as pkg` and pick pkg.default||pkg.Client.
ci-bot: CI: sampleapp-edge-smoke failed, logs in artifacts/1742000000/.
sylvie: Long term: require clean ESM entrypoint in published SDK, add CI smoke across Vite/Webpack/Rollup that runs a tiny instantiation in Miniflare. Filed infra ticket and added small repro link.
